result.summary: The page is largely intact, with no clearly broken functionality. The main concerns are minor visual/layout issues: an apparent stray character in the delivery address line, slightly awkward alignment of the promo banner's call-to-action button, and small or slightly off-center icon touch targets.

issues.description: The address line for the delivery location appears to have a stray tilde-like mark or overlapping character between the address text and the chevron.
issues.suggestion: Check the address row for a stray character and ensure proper spacing between the address text and the dropdown chevron.

issues.description: The promo banner's 'Order now' button appears misaligned, with the button partly overlapping the promotional text area rather than sitting cleanly below it.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the banner's internal layout so the headline, subtext, and button stack with consistent padding and no overlap.

issues.description: Several touch targets appear very small, particularly the bell/notification icon in the top-right corner and the small 'See all' links, and the search icon's magnifier looks offset from its circular glyph.
issues.suggestion: Increase the tap area of icons and links to at least 44x44 px and verify the search icon rendering so the magnifier is centered within its circle.
